name: desktop-hosted-lint
goal: Desktop lint passes: the hosted read files and two tests meet the complexity, ternary, import, class and length limits with their behaviour and assertions unchanged.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Desktop lint: 10 errors in 7 files (complexity 12, 14 and 19, nested ternary, unused name, import() types, 239 lines, two classes). Typecheck and audit already pass.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: bun run lint exit 1, 10 problems: /tmp/harness-runtime-desktop-lint.log and /tmp/harness-desktop-lint-red.log. Baseline of 8 affected test files: 31 passed.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Offline read, bounded response and binding check split into named parts; kinds table; typed imports and a row helper in the retirement test; one stub class became a function.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: bun run lint exit 0; typecheck 0 errors; audit passes; same 8 files 31 passed, six hosted tests unchanged; isolation test still fails 2 of 4 on a racy in-memory service.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
